Existing stations,all ingredients and stored cell energy are assumed available. These simultaneous operations share the stated hours; no jobs/contracts income is stacked.

Crafting occurs only after complete current station/item/count/output-capacity validation. Output quantities in this model assume an admitted successful operation. Failed, cancelled, stale, insufficient-input and overflowing operations must produce no output and consume no ingredients; reload/replay and rapid repeated clicks require focused runtime checks.

Items use separately named produced or consumed item units, with kind=item and positive quantities in by_kind.item; they are never added into money supply. Native furnace XP has its own player_xp_expedition unit. Currency totals apply only to separately reported Vault and premium tokens.

All recipe guns omit GunCurrentAmmoCount and start loaded=0. Source ammo identities are retained, but the current Paper firearm adapter accepts common native ammunition across calibers; native gun behavior remains the existing10 profiles. Source cost fidelity is not equal combat utility or full mod mechanics.

Mod materials require source PDC identities; ordinary carrier iron/gold/etc cannot satisfy a mod component ingredient. Old untagged loot is not retroactively converted because its original identity is unrecoverable. Plain vanilla items still satisfy genuine vanilla ingredient rows.

The93 source loot tables, rolls, weights, quantities, empty outcomes and finite shared claim policy stay unchanged. Near-city additional container accessibility and permitted administrator flight may change time to reach eligible containers, but neither exploration speed nor opening/table mix is measured or reweighted here.

Shared physical containers are finite once per coordinate, not per viewer/day. Source ore blocks are finite world stock, not replenishing rewards. Seven-day scenario multiplication requires sufficient distinct unclaimed inputs or new exploration; it does not assert a global weekly cap, renewal or guaranteed multi-account supply.

The press is found or crafted from1shaft+1andesite_casing+1iron_block;2andesite_alloy->8shaft, and1stripped log/wood+1andesite_alloy->1casing. A complete example route builds T1,T2,T3,AMMO and one DB-2,AKM,AF-46, plus one iron ammo box. It is a representative material bill, not a mandatory all66-gun purchase or measured time to accumulate. A newly crafted press setup is itemized separately from an already owned/found press, with7shaft remainder; native blast-furnace setup,fuel and tool remain separate non-free prerequisites.
